title: The Practice Calls

cards.text: Don't listen to voicemails from your own number.
Every night at 3:12, my phone calls itself while I sleep.
The voicemail is my voice, whispering, "Don't open the wardrobe."
The first ones sounded croaky and wrong. Each night, it sounds more like me.
This morning, the wardrobe door was open a crack.
Last night's message said, "I know you're listening. I'm nearly ready."
Tonight at 3:12, my phone stayed dark. My voice spoke from the wardrobe.
"Hi, Mum. It's me. Can I come home?"

outro: Follow for a new story every night.
